message.content: All probes pass. Now recording final SHAs and writing the two required reports.

function.name: exec
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace
{
echo '== AFTER resource SHAs (outputs/skill) =='
sha256sum outputs/skill/SKILL.md outputs/skill/scripts/*.py
echo '== test suite result SHAs =='
sha256sum tmp/evidence/before_original22.txt tmp/evidence/after_original22.txt tmp/evidence/after_contract.json.stdout outputs/independent_retest/RESULTS.json
echo '== skill package contents (must be only necessary resources) =='
find outputs/skill -type f | sort
} | tee tmp/evidence/after_sha_versions.txt
python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/workspace/outputs/independent_retest/RESULTS.json'));print('contract rows pass/total:',d['pass'],'/',d['total'])"
diff /workspace/inputs/previous_skill/SKILL.md /workspace/outputs/skill/SKILL.md > /dev/null && echo SKILL_UNCHANGED || echo SKILL_EDITED_AS_EXPECTED","workdir":"/workspace"}
